How the sample book works

  1. Browse

    Filter by blind family or by colour. Every swatch carries its real name or code from our range.

  2. Pin

    Tap a swatch to see what it is made for, then request it. It goes into your sample pouch.

  3. Ask for samples

    Send the pouch to Sonja by form, WhatsApp or email. We can send you samples upon request.

    Beyond the swatch

    From sample to window

    Choose it, measure it, order it

    1. Choose the type and colourUse this book, then ask for samples if you want the real thing in your hand.
    2. Measure your windowsMeasure yourself with our guide for an extra 10% discount, or have us measure for you.
    3. Send your detailsBy form, WhatsApp or email. A quote is free and comes by email.
    4. Accept, then pay the depositAfter you accept the quote we raise an official order. Once the deposit is paid, a measurer checks your measurements if you are in Durban and the surrounding areas.
    5. Delivered or fittedDelivered straight to your doorstep, or fitted at your home or office.

    Good to know

    Custom-made means no returns

    Because all our blinds are custom-made, we do not accept returns. That is exactly why it pays to see the real sample first.

    3-year carry-in guarantee

    On all blinds. Send a photo of a factory fault and we will say whether it goes to the factory or can be fixed on site.

    Measure it yourself

    An extra 10% discount when you send your own measurements.

    Ask about self-measuring insurance: 3% of the total.

    Or we measure

    Call-out from R300, refunded when you order. The fee depends on distance from Pinetown.

    Fitting

    From R110 to R150 per blind, depending on how many, plus the call-out. Panel blinds R200, outdoor roller blinds R500.
